newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-KANU RELEASED FROM HOSPITAL AFTER HEART SURGERY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KANU RELEASED FROM HOSPITAL AFTER HEART SURGERY.

text.p: Nigerian striker Nwankwo Kanu has left hospital in the United States after heart surgery, his Italian club Internazionale said on Thursday.

The club issued a statement saying that the Cleveland Clinic in Ohio, where Kanu had a plastic aortic valve inserted in a four-hour operation last month, had allowed the 20-year-old player to leave and said he was in "good" condition.
The hospital said Kanu was pursuing a daily rehabilitation programme following the surgery.
"Kanu is making good progress and is regaining his strength. The next step will be for him to undergo a long-term rehabilitation programme which could last several months."
Kanu's playing career came to an abrupt end after his heart problem was detected by Inter shortly after they had signed him from Ajax Amsterdam.
Kanu stood out when he captained Nigeria's gold medal winning team at the Atlanta Olympics last summer.
